summary: E-invoicing for France in Business Central covers electronic invoicing with UBL 2.1 and Factur-X, and E-Reporting for transactions outside mandatory B2B e-invoicing. It answers questions about formats, incoming invoice import, and submitting transactions to the tax authority via partner platforms.
overview:
This section covers the French local functionality for meeting the electronic invoicing reform. It has two pages.

The first page explains how to enable electronic invoicing with UBL 2.1 and Factur-X for B2B transactions using the E-Reporting FR extension. It covers PEPPOL BIS 3.0 support, import of incoming Factur-X and PEPPOL BIS 3.0 invoices, and validation against French business rules. The second page explains the E-Reporting FR e-document format. It is used for transactions outside the mandatory B2B e-invoicing scope, such as B2C, cross-border, exports and intra-community sales.

Start with the UBL 2.1 and Factur-X page if you need to send or receive B2B invoices. Move to the E-Reporting page if you must report other transactions to the tax authority through a partner-dissemination platform such as Pagero or Avalara.
key_points: Electronic invoicing for France is enabled through the E-Reporting FR extension.
Supported formats include UBL 2.1 invoice generation, PEPPOL BIS 3.0, and Factur-X PDF/A-3 hybrid invoices.
Incoming Factur-X and PEPPOL BIS 3.0 invoices can be imported.
E-invoices are validated against French business rules.
The E-Reporting FR e-document format covers B2C, cross-border, export and intra-community transactions.
E-reporting data is submitted to the tax authority through partner-dissemination platforms such as Pagero or Avalara.
E-reporting generates an XML payload and tracks the Service Status and E-Reporting Acceptance Date.
Both batch and individual submission workflows are supported, and an E-Reporting Transaction Type is available.

issues: The overview says both pages are based on the E-Reporting FR extension and the e-document framework. The summaries only tie the first page to the E-Reporting FR extension, and only the second page to an e-document format. The sentence was reworded to describe each page as its summary does.
Key point 2 calls PEPPOL BIS 3.0 an 'outgoing format'. The source only says 'PEPPOL BIS 3.0 support', so the wording was made neutral.
